item.title: WSDOT to close northbound I-405 in Bellevue, WA overnight for sign work
item.description: WSDOT is warning drivers to expect an overnight full closure of the northbound I-405 in Bellevue on Monday.

item.title: Seattle weather: Fresh powder on area ski slopes
item.description: On and off showers possible throughout the week with additional snow chances in the mountains. Drier skies by the weekend with frosty mornings, especially Sunday morning.

item.title: Seattle unveils 2026 FIFA World Cup fan celebration sites
item.description: Seattle will host multiple free "Fan Celebration Locations" for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, including Seattle Center, Pacific Place, Waterfront Park and Victory Hall.

item.title: Seattle traveler describes shelter-in-place in Puerto Vallarta
item.description: A Seattle woman described how she sheltered-in-place following the eruption of violence in Mexico following the capture and death of cartel leader “El Mencho."

item.title: WA man with suspended license arrested for driving through school crosswalk
item.description: Pierce County Sheriff’s Deputies say they arrested a man for reckless driving, after he disregarded a school official and drove through a crosswalk while kids were in the street.

item.title: State budget proposal hits record spending amid multi billion dollar deficit
item.description: Washington House and Senate Democrats unveiled supplemental budget proposals to address a more than $2 billion deficit in the 2025–2027 budget cycle.

item.title: ‘This is just cruel’: Harbor seal shot in head, now fighting to survive
item.description: A harbor seal is fighting for her life after rescuers discovered she had been shot in Hood Canal, a case wildlife advocates say may be part of a disturbing trend.

item.title: Man accused in Seattle Capitol Hill fatal shooting held on $2 million bail
item.description: A man is being held on $2 million bail for a fatal shooting in Seattle's Capitol Hill neighborhood on Feb. 20.

item.title: Seattle weather: Mostly cloudy Tuesday, showers mainly south and in the Cascades
item.description: Tuesday will start with morning clouds and patchy areas of fog, but the afternoon is looking mainly dry for the lowlands.

item.title: Lynnwood clips Flock's wings: Contract canceled with surveillance camera company
item.description: The Lynnwood City Council has decided to cut ties with Flock Safety and its surveillance camera systems.
